research_question: What does SBI VC Trade's newly reported JPYSC balance and lending activity measure, and does it establish XRP, XRPL or Circle-linked capital flows?

definitions.handled_balance: SBI VC Trade explicitly defines JPYSC handled balance as on-chain balance plus lending balance.
definitions.lending_balance: JPYSC lent by customers to SBI VC Trade in exchange for a rental fee.
definitions.scope: VCTRADE service only; BITPOINT service excluded.

key_findings.interpretation: These are outstanding platform balances and a customer-to-exchange lending exposure. They are not transaction turnover, public-chain settlement volume, external net capital inflow, XRP collateral, XRP purchases or evidence of XRP demand.
limits: The two reported figures are lower-bound thresholds (exceeded), not exact balances.
The handled balance already includes the lending balance; never add the two figures together.
The lending asset's deployment by SBI VC Trade is not disclosed in this release.
The published rates and terms are the offers as of November 2, 2026 and can change with market conditions.
The product is not a bank deposit, is not covered by deposit insurance, and early cancellation during the lending term is generally unavailable.

key_findings.publisher: SBI Holdings / SBI Shinsei Trust Bank / SBI VC Trade / Startale
claims: SBI Shinsei Trust Bank is the JPYSC issuer.
SBI VC Trade distributes JPYSC and initially limited use to VCTRADE accounts.
External-wallet withdrawals were unavailable at initial launch.
Public-chain circulation was a future step after legal, tax and supervisory matters were resolved; no specific public chain was named in the announcement.
key_findings.interpretation: The November 2 handled/lending balance does not establish public XRPL supply. The launch conditions are incompatible with treating JPYSC as an already-live public XRPL asset at that date.

key_findings.publisher: SBI Shinsei Trust Bank / SBI VC Trade
claims: The issuer began managing a portion of JPYSC trust assets in short-term Japanese government bonds.
The announcement described approximately JPY20.1 billion issued, approximately JPY6.9 billion in JPYSC lending applications, and approximately JPY27 billion combined.
The release described a statutory framework allowing eligible short-term government bonds or deposits within specified limits.
limits: The figures are a September 7 snapshot, not November 2 reserve composition.
The November 2 handled-balance definition is on-chain balance plus lending balance; do not silently equate every prior issued-balance definition with a later on-chain balance.
The JPY1 billion figure is a portion of trust assets, not the entirety of JPYSC reserves.

claims: SBI Holdings and Startale joined the Open Standard initiative, which SBI described as having more than 140 participating companies, including Coinbase.
SBI and Startale said they were considering a proof of concept for interoperability between JPYSC and Open USD (OUSD), subject to OUSD's on-chain launch.
limits: Shared initiative membership does not establish a bilateral Coinbase-JPYSC agreement.
The JPYSC-OUSD work is exploration, not a live bridge, production route or measured settlement volume.
No XRP or XRPL route is stated.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI is developing a multi-rail digital-money strategy spanning XRP-using remittance, JPYSC, RLUSD/USDC distribution and broader tokenized-asset initiatives.
competing_hypotheses.support: Separate official SBI, Ripple, Circle and Startale announcements.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: The separate products and partnerships do not prove shared liquidity, common settlement routes or integrated production flows.

competing_hypotheses.claim: JPYSC handled-balance growth creates direct XRP spot demand.
competing_hypotheses.support: SBI has separate XRP remittance activity and XRPL research.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: JPYSC's initial VCTRADE-only scope, no public-chain deployment, no stated XRP collateral, no XRP bridge route and no disclosed XRP purchases.

competing_hypotheses.claim: JPYSC lending balances represent new external capital entering crypto markets.
competing_hypotheses.support: Customers lend JPYSC to SBI VC Trade and receive a rental fee.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: The reported balance is a platform lending exposure; the release does not disclose use of proceeds, onward deployment, market purchases or external settlement.

competing_hypotheses.claim: JPYSC growth is already operationally connected to Circle's SBI JV or Coinbase distribution.
competing_hypotheses.support: SBI separately participates in Open Standard and has a Circle SBI Japan JV; Coinbase is an Open Standard participant.
competing_hypotheses.counterevidence: No bilateral JPYSC-Coinbase integration, JPYSC-Circle settlement route or production interoperability is disclosed. Circle's Q2 2026 filing says Circle SBI Japan had no significant operating results through June 30.

feature_admission.jpysc_handled_balance: Platform-specific outstanding balance feature only; preserve the official definition (on-chain balance plus lending balance), service scope and as-of timestamp.
feature_admission.jpysc_lending_balance: Separate customer-to-SBI-VC-Trade lending exposure and product-uptake feature; not transaction volume or deployed capital.
feature_admission.jpysc_reserve_composition: Use only dated trust-asset disclosures; do not carry September 7 composition forward to November 2.
feature_admission.jpysc_public_chain_supply: NOT_ADMITTED until issuer identifies chain, contract, deployment date, public transfer capability and reconciled ledger supply.
feature_admission.xrp_spot_demand: NOT_ADMITTED from JPYSC balances or lending alone.
feature_admission.circle_coinbase_crossrail: Categorical relationship only until executed route, chain, contract, volume and timestamps are independently verified.

forecast.reason: JPYSC product balances are not synchronized XRP market/flow features and provide no validated causal link to XRP price.

next_actions: Track exact daily JPYSC issued, on-chain, lending and handled balances without double counting.
Obtain issuer trust-asset composition updates and maturity/eligibility details for short-term Japanese government bonds.
Verify any public-chain migration announcement, chain ID, issuer account/contract and external transfer availability before recording public supply.
Verify whether JPYSC-OUSD interoperability advances beyond exploration and identify actual transactions and counterparties.
Keep JPYSC lending, Circle USDC distribution and SBI XRP remittance as separate graph and feature families.
Do not infer XRP spot demand without synchronized XRP acquisition, disposal, bridge and market-liquidity observations.
